name: What preparation is needed before a carpenter begins trim work?

mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed before a carpenter begins trim work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your carpenter arrives, clear furniture at least three to four feet away from walls and remove fragile wall decor from the room. Finish carpentry requires setting up a miter saw station, work tables, and air compressor lines, usually staged in an adjoining garage, porch, or clear room. If your project includes window casings, remove blinds or curtains and ensure window sills are completely clear. Disclosing any past wall repairs or hidden wiring near baseboards also helps avoid unexpected delays during nailing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear furniture away from walls, take down curtains and wall decor, and ensure an open, level area is available for saw tables and equipment setup.
